text: Well, well. A moon nobody owns.
Then it might as well be mine.
Roll up, roll up! One peek at the moon, only one acorn!
I've looked at that moon for two hundred years... for free.
Ah, but that was the old moon, madam. This one is mine.
Ooooh. Shiny.
Who sold it to you?
Nobody. I found it. Finders, keepers.
Then I found it too. It's right there.
That's a... counterfeit moon. Very cheap. Very dangerous.
New rule. No more free peeking over the fence.
Two acorns? Yesterday it was one!
Demand is high, my friend. The moon is very popular.
It's... gone.
Where's our moon, cat?!
Refund! Refund! Refund!
Stay calm! I'll... fetch it back!
Come back, you ungrateful moon! I made you famous!
...Help?
You can't lose the moon, Pom. You never had it.
There. Still free. Still mine. Still yours.
Right. Everyone... form a line. Refunds this way.
Well, well. A moon everybody owns.
Now you're getting it.
So. How much do you think I could get for the sun?
Pom.
